_note: The pinspots: two lights on one RF remote, so they are one device and always do the same (room_service/adapters/rf_light.py), sent by the BroadLink RM4 Pro. Learn and test each button on the Lights setup page (Remote controls), or: .venv/bin/python -m room_service.adapters.broadlink_rf --file config/room/rf/pinspot.json learn <button...>. The room keeps its own record of what they are doing and presses buttons in order to reach a wanted look: power, colour, brightness steps (up/down, 'steps' of them), then the pulse and flash toggles, gap_s apart. After power at the wall they come on white at full: Reset (on, white, down x steps, off) puts the room's record right. Colour ids stay; their names are set on the Lights setup page.
